question: What lactic acid and acetic acid concentrations did LPGood have?
question_long: What lactic acid and acetic acid concentrations did the well-fermented alfalfa silage group (LPGood) have?
rendered:
According to the document, the LPGood group had significantly (p < 0.05) higher lactic acid (LA) and acetic acid (AA) concentrations than the LPBad group. The exact concentrations are:

- Lactic acid (LA): 9.18 ± 0.46 g/kg DM
- Acetic acid (AA): 11.27 ± 0.16 g/kg DM
